WITH checked_tenant AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT $1::uuid AS id), checked_member AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM memberships.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='ACTIVE'), available_units AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
 JOIN checked_tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id

 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code
 FROM "authorization".role r
 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='ACTIVE'
 WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),
      checked_assignments AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE') SELECT DISTINCT g.permission_id,g.code FROM checked_assignments a
      JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id
      JOIN grants g ON g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.role_id=a.role_id
      JOIN available_units u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE'
